question: Who will destroy the addressed one and in what form?
premises: The speaker declares a future act of destruction.
The object of destruction is the addressed one.
The speaker identifies herself as Bhadrakālī in her own form.
inference: Bhadrakālī, in her own form, will destroy the addressed one.
uncertainties: The token 'tatā' may reflect a textual variant of 'tataḥ' or 'tadā'.
plain_english: Then, having destroyed you, I, Bhadrakālī, will remain in my own form.
